What We Carry

From beginner-friendly houseplants to locally made gifts — a shop worth browsing slowly.

Living Things

Houseplants & Tropicals

We hand-select every plant. If it's on our shelf, we believe in it. We'll always tell you what light it needs and whether it's safe for pets or kids before you buy.

Low Light Pet Safe: No

Golden Pothos

Staff favorite for a reason. Variegated green-gold leaves, trails beautifully, virtually indestructible.

From $8
Indirect Light Pet Safe: Yes

Calathea Orbifolia

Bold silver-striped leaves that close at night. Loves humidity and indirect light. Fully pet and kid safe.

From $22
Any Light Pet Safe: No

Snake Plant

Architectural, forgiving, and great at improving air quality. Thrives on neglect — perfect for busy people.

From $14
Low Light Pet Safe: No

Peace Lily

Blooms in low light and tells you when it needs water by drooping slightly. A great first flowering houseplant.

From $16
Not Sure What to Pick?

We'll find the right plant for your space.

Tell us your light situation, whether you have pets, how forgetful you are about watering, and your budget. We'll point you to exactly the right plant. No pressure, no guessing.

Call to Ask
Michigan-Made

Ceramic Pots & Planters

We work with a handful of Michigan ceramicists whose pots are made to actually hold plants — proper drainage, balanced proportions, and glazes that age well.

Stoneware

Toffee Matte Planter

A Kalamazoo ceramicist's signature piece. Warm toffee glaze with a matte finish, drainage hole and matching saucer. Available in 4", 6", and 8".

$28 – $52
Stoneware

Sage Green Tapered

Clean, modern silhouette in a muted sage glaze that pairs with everything. Handthrown, each one slightly unique. 5" and 7" sizes.

$24 – $38
Stoneware

Speckled Cream Wide Bowl

A generous low profile for succulents and cacti. Speckled cream glaze with a terracotta-flecked texture. Saucer included. 6" and 9".

$32 – $48
Beyond Plants

Gifts, Candles & Supplies

Locally Poured Candles

Made in small batches by a candle maker in South Haven, Michigan. Clean-burning soy wax, 50-hour burn time. Scents include cedar & white tea, wild fig, and lake water (a spring/summer seasonal). $22–$28.

Greeting Cards

A rotating collection of illustrated cards from independent artists — botanical prints, letterpress designs, and a few funny ones about plants dying. $4.50–$7.50 each. We carry them in bulk for workshops and events, too.

Plant Care Supplies

Potting mix, perlite, pumice, worm castings, liquid fertilizer, and watering cans. We only carry what we actually use ourselves and can explain exactly why.

Small Gifts & Curiosities

Ceramic plant markers, terrarium kits, grow-your-own seed sets, plant-themed tea towels, and a small collection of gardening books. Perfect for people who are hard to buy for, or for yourself.

Seasonal Greenery

Fresh eucalyptus bundles, dried grasses, and seasonal foliage in spring and fall. We stock extra around holidays — and carry the same greenery we use in our wreath workshops so you can make one at home.

Gift Wrapping

We wrap everything.

Kraft paper and twine, a hand-stamped tag, and a sprig of something green. It's included — just ask at the register.

Can't make it in? We can help over the phone.

Not sure what plant to get, or want us to set something aside? Give us a call. We're here Wednesday through Saturday 10am–6pm and Sunday 11am–4pm.
